evidence: Supabase Edge Function reads one fixed public iCalendar feed and returns normalised future events.
Source candidate guide and KB record describe the clean-room boundary.
candidates.reusable_value: A policy-bound reader can provide reusable, read-only calendar discovery without central adapter execution.
security_posture: Never accept arbitrary URLs, private calendars, writes, or provider actions.
Minimise event fields and use fake-provider tests.
admission_gaps: External calendar-feed reuse terms and permitted fields require owner approval.
Current source parser and rate limiting are reference-only, not an approved implementation.
acceptance_checks: Run fixture-based iCalendar parser and timezone tests.
Run fake-provider conformance tests and verify no arbitrary URL path exists.

evidence: The source Edge Function and UI share an implicit event id/title/start/end response shape.
candidates.reusable_value: A minimal contract template lets future readers avoid leaking raw provider payloads or private event fields.
security_posture: Exclude descriptions, attendees, locations, and provider credentials by default.
Require explicit timezone and freshness semantics.
admission_gaps: A concrete schema and non-sensitive fixtures remain future adapter work.
acceptance_checks: Ensure catalogue output contains metadata only.

evidence: Source client handles local timezone display and a narrow midnight boundary case.
Source tests cover simple title-time formatting.
candidates.reusable_value: Documents the separation between provider event time, user display time, and optional editorial title data.
security_posture: Treat event titles as optional display metadata, not an authoritative time source.
Require DST and malformed-input fixtures before implementation.
admission_gaps: No generic timezone or recurrence test corpus exists in the source.
acceptance_checks: Keep the pattern documentation free of source feed data and credentials.
Cross-link it from the contract template.

evidence: The source accepts anonymous feedback into a Supabase user-submissions table.
candidates.reusable_value: Product-specific feedback capture is not a safe general Tool Repository asset without privacy and anti-abuse governance.
security_posture: Public inserts require independent abuse, retention, and moderation controls.
admission_gaps: Privacy notice, retention, moderation, and abuse controls are not evidenced.
acceptance_checks: Do not promote from this intake.

do_not_import: Source .env files, deployed Supabase settings, publishable keys, provider credentials, raw calendar payloads, user feedback, and product analytics.
The source Edge Function implementation, process-local cache, rate-limit map, branded UI, tide-quality rules, images, and marketing copy.
